title: Male fertility is independent of Enh13 control of Sox9 testicular expression
authors: Lubman M; Ridnik M; Stévant I; Kimchi Djanshvili Y; Abberbock E; Ziv Lhermann S; Gonen N
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Sox9增强子Enh13在小鼠睾丸发育中的时序功能，属基因调控与发育生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Testis development relies on precise temporal control of Sox9 expression, which is rapidly activated to initiate testis development and subsequently maintained to preserve Sertoli cell identity and male fertility. The distal enhancer, Enh13, is essential for Sox9 upregulation as its constitutive deletion results in complete XY male-to-female sex reversal. Enh13’s requirement across distinct developmental stages remains unexplored. We show that early gonadal deletion of Enh13 fully recapitulates XY sex reversal, demonstrating that Enh13 activity is strictly required to initiate the male pathway. In contrast, Sertoli cell-specific deletion of Enh13 after sex determination has no effect on Sox9 expression, testis architecture, or male fertility, revealing that Enh13 is dispensable for Sox9 maintenance in the differentiated testis. Chromatin accessibility identifies candidate enhancers gaining activity after sex determination, suggesting a regulatory handoff within the Sox9 locus. Finally, we show that duplicating Enh13 in the endogenous mouse locus fails to recapitulate the human XX sex reversal, suggesting that it may not be solely Enh13 sequence duplication that led to XX sex reversal in humans. To the best of our knowledge, this study represents the first in vivo conditional knockout of a developmental enhancer, allowing for temporally controlled interrogation of regulatory logic.
abstract_zh: 睾丸发育依赖于Sox9表达的精确时间调控，该基因被迅速激活以启动睾丸发育，随后得以维持以保留支持细胞（Sertoli cell）身份和雄性生育能力。远端增强子Enh13对Sox9上调至关重要，因其组成性缺失导致完全的XY雄性向雌性性别逆转。Enh13在不同发育阶段的需求尚未被探索。我们研究表明，早期性腺中Enh13的缺失完全重现了XY性别逆转，证明Enh13活性严格需要以启动雄性通路。相反，在性别决定后，支持细胞特异性缺失Enh13对Sox9表达、睾丸结构或雄性生育能力无影响，揭示Enh13在分化睾丸中对Sox9的维持是非必需的。染色质可及性识别出在性别决定后获得活性的候选增强子，提示Sox9基因座内存在调控交接。最后，我们显示，在内源性小鼠基因座中复制Enh13未能重现人类XX性别逆转，表明可能并非仅仅是Enh13序列重复导致了人类XX性别逆转。据我们所知，本研究代表了发育增强子的首个体内条件性敲除，允许对调控逻辑进行时间控制性探究。
